label: PF Backlog 209
title: Backend: plugin/registry framework (ports+adapters for providers/tools/agents/stages/validators)
body:
## Problem / why
Adding a kind/provider/tool/agent/stage currently implies core edits; it should be a registry entry + adapter.
## Goal
A generic plugin/registry framework (ports & adapters) so extensions are drop-in; the core orchestrator
depends only on ports. Generalizes capability packs (BI-0189) + provider abstraction (BI-0193).
## Acceptance criteria
- A new provider/tool/agent/stage registers via config + a small adapter, no core change; audit green.
## Verification
- Add a dummy plugin end-to-end; it appears in the roster/registry and runs.
